description:
Perform an outbound link audit on https://crawler-test.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. 

STEPS:
1. Crawl 'https://crawler-test.com/'.
2. Once the crawl finishes, identify all EXTERNAL links (links pointing to other domains).
3. Export these external links to a CSV file in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'. You can use the 'External' tab export or 'Bulk Export > Links > External Links'.
4. Write a text report to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/external_links_report.txt' that includes:
   - The total number of external links found.
   - A list of the top external domains linked to.
   - Any broken external links (if found).
   - At least one actionable recommendation.

SUCCESS CRITERIA: A CSV file containing external URL data must exist in the exports directory, and a meaningful text report must exist in the reports directory.
